extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) Air is all around us — invisible, no colour, no shape, but we can feel it. (2) Wind is air moving — we feel wind on our face, see leaves rustling, kites flying. (3) Air fills space — balloon gets bigger when we blow air into it, an 'empty' bottle is actually full of air. (4) Uses of air — breathing (living things need air), flying (kites, balloons, planes), spinning (windmills, pinwheels), cooling (fans). (5) Clean vs dirty air — trees and plants give clean air, factory smoke and car smoke make dirty air. Dirty air causes coughing and sickness. Misconceptions: 'air is not there because I cannot see it' (air is invisible but real — blow into a balloon), 'empty bottle has nothing' (bottle is full of air), 'dirty air only smells bad' (dirty air causes coughing, sneezing, burning eyes, lung diseases). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function AirGame), NOT export default. Export interface AirGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
